purpose: Task 3 — verify the startup gate and the BPB floor on the real corpus before the wave.

interpretation.scale: uniform byte model = 8.0 bpb; uniform over this 4098-token vocab ~= 12.0 bpb
interpretation.reading: 9.48 bpb at step 40 sits below uniform-over-vocab (~12) and above uniform-over-bytes (8) — the model has begun to learn and is nowhere near good, which is what 40 honest steps should look like.
interpretation.discriminator: The causal-mask leak presented as loss ~0.002 (~0.003 bpb). Observed 12.90 / 9.48. Separation from the leak signature is ~3 orders of magnitude.
interpretation.floor_is_loose_by_design: HARD_FLOOR=0.01 is a plausibility bound, not a quality gate. It is meant to be unreachable by any honest run and trivially tripped by label leakage; it does not certify that a run is good.

caveat: Reduced-size config (d_model 192 vs 704) for speed, on the real p1_distill_train_v1 corpus. Evidence about the INSTRUMENT, not a tuned result.
